verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a persistent 'memory about you' that users can inspect, edit and download. A Forget skill removes remembered information about specific topics or people. The side-chats feature was added because some users wanted separate context, which implies that context carries across conversations by default. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how memory is retrieved and applied in new chats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-conversation recall.
